messages:
Maria Chen: Thanks for joining the security segment — dropping the live Qs here so we can action.
Sanjay Patel: BYOK question first: can Private VPC customers bring keys and when?
Alex Rivera: Audit logs: default retention, enterprise options, and export SLAs?
Jess Liu: ISO readiness — are we running ISO in parallel with SOC2 or reusing artifacts?
Sanjay Patel: BYOK plan: Private/VPC BYOK target Q3 (customer KMS integration). Hosted BYOK needs HSM work, targeted Q4 pending SOC2 re-eval. Will publish gating checklist.
Tyler Nguyen: Proposed retention tiers: default 90 days; enterprise up to 7 years with S3/GCS export hooks. Export SLA: standard 24h, expedited 4h (pre-approved).
Cory Brooks: Legal flag: EU PII exports require privacy review before we promise anything.
Alex Rivera: Draft audit export line (JSONL example): {"ts":"2026-03-23T16:22:10Z","request_id":"req_abc123","actor":"svc:acme","route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood/gpt-13b","tokens_in":42,"tokens_out":210,"outcome":"success","ip":"10.2.3.4","kms_key_id":"projects/foo/locations/global/keyRings/r1/cryptoKeys/k1"}
Jess Liu: ISO scope will align with SOC2 but add supplier assessments and supply-chain controls. I'll produce a gap matrix.
Sanjay Patel: Key rotation approach: KMS handles rotation, runtime supports rewrap at lease boundaries so rotations are online. Integration tests required.
engops-bot: CI: private-kms-integration merged to staging at 2360010040 — smoke tests passing ✅
Maria Chen: Action items: 1) @Sanjay publish BYOK timeline and gating checklist (EOD Tue). 2) @Alex draft audit-export schema + retention pricing. 3) @Jess own ISO readiness/gap matrix (by Fri). 4) @Tyler draft SLA/KPI messaging for public site.
Alex Rivera: I'll push schema draft to docs and tag security/privacy for review.
Cory Brooks: Add cost estimates for long-retention storage and egress to pricing notes.
Tyler Nguyen: SLA suggestions: p99 <= 350ms for small hosted models, error budget 0.1%/month, audit-export SLAs as proposed.
Maria Chen: Good catch on legal — loop in @legal and @privacy-team before customer-facing statements.
Jess Liu: Will coordinate vendor assessment checklist for ISO.
Sanjay Patel: Scheduling an ops sync for BYOK gating and runtime tests.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. Keep follow-ups in this thread and escalate if blockers appear. :thumbsup:
